# FIRST_RUN summary (generated by scripts/summarize_first_run.py from results/raw)

All numbers are from the toy described in configs/first_run.json. They are numerical checks, not proofs, and say nothing directly about trained Mamba/S4/S5 models.

## Pre-registered hypotheses (primary config: uniform-real, 32 units)

| id | status | kind |
|---|---|---|
| H1 | PASS | engineering check of a known identity |
| H2 | PASS | known convergence order (numerical check, not a proof) |
| H3 | PASS | known convergence order (numerical check, not a proof) |
| H4 | PASS | toy constructed to be grid-dependent (demonstration, not discovery) |
| H5a | PASS | engineering check (exact ZOH vs independent RK4 on held path) |
| H5b | PASS | known first-order hold convergence (numerical check) |
| H6 | PASS | toy constructed to be grid-dependent (demonstration) |
| H7a | PASS | engineering check (additivity of exact integral) |
| H7b | PASS | readout property (known in principle) |
| H7c_original | FAIL | MIS-SPECIFIED pre-run (see amendment A2); evaluated verbatim |
| H7c_restated | PASS | known Riemann-sum convergence (numerical check) |
| H8 | PASS | readout property under density change |
